'''Docking Bay 82''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking area]] in the [[Coruscant Spaceport]], located on the edge of the [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Hot Pursuit" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal [[Urbax]] was hired by [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]] to attack the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] lawman [[Miel Muwn]] in the docking bay.<ref name="Hot Pursuit" />
